title: sambucus pubens var. xanthocarpa
intro: Sambucus pubens var. xanthocarpa, commonly known as American elderberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Adoxaceae family. The health benefits of American elderberry include its potential to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections such as colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of American elderberry are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of American elderberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
